[0-5s] Extreme high shot as the dragon and rider plunge downward through the clouds in a steep dive, close on the boy gripping tight with one hand steadying a bundle as wind roars past, the dragon's long body ripples and twists mid-dive dodging a jagged mountain peak jutting through the clouds while fire sparks along its spine as it accelerates even faster. [5-10s] A sudden hard pull-up flattens the boy against the dragon's neck from the G-force, the dragon levels out and skims just above a rolling white cloud sea, the boy laughs exhilarated with his spear held high overhead, then the dragon weaves rapidly side to side through a narrow canyon of towering cloud formations. [10-15s] Close-up on the dragon's snarling face with embers glowing deep in its throat, it unleashes a roaring blast of fire straight ahead lighting the clouds bright orange, then banks into a tight victory spiral trailing fire and smoke, ending with the dragon and boy silhouetted against a blazing sunset sky soaring triumphantly. Frame holds steady at the end.

Un jeune garçon aux cheveux noirs avec une coiffure en chignon, à la peau bronzée, portant une tunique gris-bleu et un short noir avec des protège-jambes enroulés, deux grands paquets ronds enveloppés dans un tissu blanc attachés à son dos, chevauche un immense dragon serpentin gris foncé sans ailes avec de petites cornes et des flammes vacillantes le long de sa colonne vertébrale et de sa queue, volant rapidement à travers d'épais nuages blancs.
